Current Logo
Original Raster
  • Resolution: Cropped from an 1140px raster screenshot. Shows blurriness, compression noise, and raster fringing on high-DPI retina screens.
  • Centering: Off-center by -15px (X) and +38px (Y). In circular launcher masks, the dial curves unevenly and sags down-left.
  • Sparkle: Needle tip has faint, low-contrast glow. Satellites and stems dissolve at 64px dock size.
New High-Definition Logo
Mathematical Vector
  • Resolution: Pure scalable vector graphics (SVG master). Crystal-clear rendering at 1024px, 2048px, or any DPI with zero artifacts.
  • Centering: Mathematically centered & concentric with icon boundary. Uniform margins on all sides across iOS, Android Pixel, and Samsung OneUI.
  • Sparkle: Radiant 4-point diamond star flare + luminous bloom + high-contrast satellite nodes for instant recognition on mobile home screens.
